approved: user decision (D-lens-research): fetch once, pinned, into a gitignored cache: the first 1,000 WikiText-103 records at b08601e0, jpp_lens at d7efc0de installed into its own env, J++'s six eval item files. Nothing else is downloaded.

jpp_lens.fetch: git init; git fetch --depth 1 origin <commit>; git checkout FETCH_HEAD
jpp_lens.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE and NOTICE at the commit)

jpp_eval_items.note: The items are read from the gitignored checkout; only these hashes and counts are committed.

jpp_lens.install: uv pip install --offline --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e <checkout> (src/ on the path)

not_installed.pandas: pin 3.0.5; no Python 3.12 build in the shared .venv or the uv cache, and no download beyond the three sources is approved. scripts/jpp_cli.py and lens_evals import it at the top, so neither imports here.
not_installed.pyarrow: pin 25.0.0; same reason. WikiText is read by R3_fetch.py's own parquet reader instead.
not_installed.datasets: pin 5.0.1; only jlens/examples.py uses it, to stream WikiText unpinned; the pinned rows replace it.

deviations: torch 2.14.1, transformers 5.20.0, numpy 2.5.4, huggingface_hub 2.2.0 and accelerate 1.15.0 are the shared .venv's, not jpp_lens's pins (reused, not downloaded); pytest 9.1.1 matches its pin.
pandas, pyarrow and datasets are not installed (see not_installed): scripts/jpp_cli.py and lens_evals cannot be imported until pandas is, which needs a download not yet approved.

wikitext.fetch: huggingface_hub.HfFileSystem at the revision, range requests: the footer, then row groups in order, decoded by R3_fetch.py's parquet reader; the shard is not stored
wikitext.selection: the first 1000 rows with len(text.strip()) >= 600, in stream order, text kept unstripped (jpp_lens src/jlens/examples.py:9-27)
wikitext.sequence_sha256_rule: sha256 of the records' sha256 hex digests joined by newlines, in order
wikitext.fit_prompts: the first 64 records (J++'s 64 fit prompts); all 1,000 feed the router
wikitext.note: Only row indices and hashes are committed; the texts stay in the gitignored cache. Whether this prefix holds all of Miru's 1,000 rechunked prompts is checked when they are rebuilt.
